"接下来说说最神秘的魂谷!至于说他神秘？是因为魂谷一直都是神出鬼没的。没人知道魂谷的准确据点在哪里?只知道是在十万大山深处的某一山谷。""十万大山是我们大乾最大的一条山脉，传说有十万座大山!所以才叫十万大山!"林海解释道。江流了然的点了点头，继续看着林海。"魂谷不但据点神秘，就连修炼的功法都一样神秘，据说是修炼的魂诀。我没见人使用过，不知道确实的功法效果。只是大概听过传闻，好像跟灵魂有关的。我只知道跟灵魂有关的功法，那是要从九品突破到宗师了!"林海一脸向往的说道。"修炼灵魂跟突破宗师有关?那是不是说魂谷里的都是宗师?"江流一脸好奇的说道。"怎么可能!如果魂谷里的都是宗师的话。那他们还不翻天啊!据传魂谷最高的战力也就是一位大宗师!至于有多少宗师？就没人清楚了，肯定不会很多。不然不可能那么低调的。""他们也就是修炼的功法奇特点而已。并不是跟进阶宗师一样，修炼灵魂作用肉身。应该是用他们的功法魂诀，特意先去修炼灵魂罢了。"林海说道。"来!我们继续喝!"林海说完，举起杯子对两人示意了一下，仰头一饮而尽。江流，海叔，也举起杯子陪了一杯，江流跟着连忙倒满。"异兽谷，一说起这个就可以猜到，应该跟异兽有关了。我们平时进补的兽肉就是异兽肉。""异兽，异于寻常野兽的是为异兽。异兽浑身是宝，皮可以做护甲，角，牙齿，筋，毛发可以做武器，肉可以用来进补，血可以用于浸泡滋养身体，兽核可以拿来修炼！""异兽对于我们人类来说，可以说全身都是宝。但是我们人类对于异兽来说，也一样是宝。因为异兽可以吞噬人类进化。""江兄弟，你别一副大惊小怪的表情!弱肉强食!在哪里都要遵循这个生存规则的!"林海见江流脸色不太好劝慰道。江流没说什么地点了点头。林海接着说道:"异兽谷，那是以驯兽，养兽，控兽，出名的。他们修炼御兽诀，可以驱使异兽战斗，修炼，日常干活。倒是神奇。但是也有过异兽弑主的情况出现，虽然很少。所以还是存在一定威胁的。""尸谷，说起这个就是人神共愤的了。因为这个尸谷是炼制尸体作为战斗工具的。因为之前的尸谷做得很绝，到处挖人祖坟，把人家埋下去的祖宗先人挖出炼制成尸傀尸儡，然后跟人家战斗。""这样的情形谁能忍受？毕竟人都会有一死，谁也不想死后被这样对待，所以最终激起民愤，三大超级宗门就派人来灭了尸谷。""所以尸谷已经消声匿迹一百多年了。最近才偶有消息传出，但是收敛了很多。没听过有到处挖人祖坟的事发生了。""八大谷的最后一个奇毒谷，是最不能招惹的。不然你死都不知道怎么死的。奇毒谷的下毒手段，根本就是无影无踪的。在你发觉之前，就可能已经中毒了。奇毒谷是一个种满了奇花异草的，风景美丽的山谷。"江流望着林海一脸想去奇毒谷看看的表情，有点无语。暗道:难道你不知道越美丽的东西越毒?"奇毒谷，全谷都是修炼毒功的。用毒花、毒草、毒虫、毒物来修炼的。五花八门的，我也不太清楚。毕竟很清楚的应该都已经死了。奇毒谷是不可能让自己的秘密泄露出去的。"林海有点嘘唏的说道。"好了，林小子，说累了吧!我们继续喝!感慨那么多干啥?今日有酒今朝醉!明日愁来明日愁!"海叔呼喝着举起了酒杯。"好!喝!江兄弟，看一下，酒还够不够？不够我再去拿多几瓶过来。"林海接着说道。江流，侧身看了看，说道:"还好几瓶呢，喝完再说了!""好!我们接着喝!"三人举起杯子，满饮此杯。

> Chapter 25 New Year’s Eve Episode 3 (Page 1)
"Next, let's talk about the most mysterious Soul Valley! As for it being mysterious? It's because the Soul Valley has always been elusive. No one knows where the exact location of the Soul Valley is? We only know that it is in a valley deep in the Shiwanda Mountain." "Shiwandashan is the largest mountain range in our Dagan. Legend has it that there are 100,000 mountains! That's why it is called Shiwandashan!" Lin Hai explained. Jiang Liu nodded clearly and continued to look at Lin Hai. "Not only is the stronghold of Soul Valley mysterious, but the techniques used to practice are also mysterious. It is said to be the soul technique for cultivation. I have never seen anyone use it, so I don't know the exact effects of the techniques. I have only heard rumors that they seem to be related to the soul. I only know the techniques related to the soul, which are necessary to break through from the ninth level to the master!" Lin Hai said with a look of longing. "Cultivation of the soul is related to breaking through the master? Does that mean that everyone in the Soul Valley is a master?" Jiang Liu said with a curious face. "How is it possible! If everyone in the Soul Valley is a grandmaster, then they are not going crazy! It is said that the highest combat power in the Soul Valley is a grand master! As for how many grandmasters there are? No one knows, there must not be many. Otherwise, they can't be so low-key." "They just have the unique characteristics of the skills they practice. It is not like the follow-up masters, who practice the soul to use the body. They should use their soul skills to cultivate the soul first." Lin Hai said. "Come! Let's keep drinking!" After Lin Hai finished speaking, he raised his cup and gestured to the two of them, then raised his head and drank it all. Jiang Liu and Uncle Hai also raised their cups to drink with them, and Jiang Liu quickly filled them up. "In the Valley of Alien Beasts, you can guess that it has something to do with alien beasts. The animal meat we usually take as a supplement is the meat of alien beasts." "Exotic beasts are alien beasts that are different from ordinary beasts. Alien beasts are full of treasures. Their skin can be used as armor, their horns, teeth, tendons, and hair can be used as weapons. Their meat can be used as a tonic. Their blood can be used to soak and nourish the body, and their cores can be taken. Come and practice! "" Alien beasts are all treasures to us humans, but we humans are also treasures to alien beasts, because alien beasts can devour human beings and evolve. "Brother Jiang, don't look so fussy! The law of the jungle must be followed everywhere!" Lin Hai comforted Jiang Liu when he saw it. Jiang Liu nodded without saying anything. Lin Hai continued: "The Valley of Alien Beasts is famous for taming, raising, and controlling beasts. They practice beast control techniques, which can drive alien beasts to fight, practice, and do daily work. It is magical. However, there have been cases of alien beasts killing their owners, although they are rare. So there is still a certain threat." "Corpse Valley, talking about this, there is still a certain threat. This is because the Corpse Valley was used to refine corpses as fighting tools. The Corpse Valley was very good at digging up people's ancestors' graves and refining them into corpse puppets, and then fighting against them. Who can bear this situation? After being treated like this, the three super sects finally sent people to destroy the Corpse Valley. "So the Corpse Valley has been disappearing for more than a hundred years, but it has been much restrained." "The last strange poison valley in the Eight Great Valleys is the worst. It can be provoked. Otherwise, you won't know how to die. The poisoning method of Qidu Valley is completely invisible. You may have been poisoned before you realize it. Qidu Valley is a valley full of exotic flowers and plants, and the scenery is beautiful." Jiang Liu looked at Lin Hai with an expression of wanting to visit Qidu Valley. Secretly: Don’t you know that the more beautiful things are?More poison? "Qi Du Valley, the whole valley is full of people who practice poison skills. They use poisonous flowers, poisonous weeds, poisonous insects, and poisons to practice. There are all kinds of them, and I don't know much about them. After all, those who know clearly should be dead. It is impossible for Qi Du Valley to let its secrets leak out." Lin Hai said with a little sigh. "Okay, Mr. Lin, tell me you're tired! Let's keep drinking! Why do we sigh so much? I have wine today and I'm drunk today! I'll worry about tomorrow and worry about tomorrow!" Uncle Hai shouted and raised his glass. "Okay! Drink! Brother Jiang, take a look, is the wine enough? If not, I will get a few more bottles." Lin Hai continued. Jiang Liu looked sideways and said, "There are still a few bottles left. Let's talk after we finish drinking!" "Okay! Let's continue drinking!" The three of them raised their glasses and drank to the top.
